x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"requisition_whole_change_order_item\":{\"work_completed_this_period\":1000,\"materials_presently_stored\":500,\"work_completed_retainage_retained_this_period\":100,\"materials_stored_retainage_currently_retained\":50,\"work_completed_retainage_released_this_period\":0,\"work_completed_this_period_quantity\":10,\"ssr_manual_override\":false,\"comment\":\"Installation charges\",\"status\":\"draft\"}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/requisitions/%7Brequisition_id%7D/whole_change_order_items/%7Bid%7D", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
